headline: Lowe's comps rose 1.3% on Pro, online and home services despite pressured housing; set FY2026 comps flat to +2%.
guidance_note: FY2026: sales $92-94bn (+7-9%), comps flat to +2%, adj op margin 11.6-11.8%, adj EPS ~$12.25-12.75.
key_messages: Comps +1.3%: ticket +3.6% (price increases, mix toward Pro and appliances), transactions -2.3%.
Growth driven by Pro, online and home services; big-ticket discretionary DIY still pressured.
Ellison: the housing macro remains pressured; company focused on what it can control.
Sales +10.8% to $20.6bn, largely from FBM and ADG; adj EPS $1.98 (+2.6%) beat ~$1.94.
Awarded $125m in discretionary frontline associate bonuses.

consumer.big_ticket: Continued pressure on big-ticket, discretionary DIY projects amid housing volatility.
consumer.pricing: Price increases contributed to the 3.6% comparable ticket gain.

macro_read: Comps are being propped up by price and Pro mix while DIY traffic falls, consistent with a stagnant housing market and cautious homeowners.

sources.label: Zacks: Lowe's Q4 beat on Pro strength
